segments.text: Listing part A. You hear a gastroenterologist talking to a patient called Joseph Alvarez.
For questions 1 to 12, complete the notes with a word or short phrase. You now have 30 seconds to look at the notes.
Hello Mr Alvarez, your GP has sent us the letter about your problems, but why don't
Could you tell me in your own words what's been happening?
Ah yes, well I've had blood in my urine and like this sharp kind of chest pain.
I had an ECG for that but it didn't show anything serious.
But the pain was still there.
So my doctor sent me for an ultrasound of my abdomen but the result was alright.
I think that's why he sent me to see you.
Yes, and you had a normal endoscopy two years ago.
Well how are you now?
My stomach always feels full up. It's just the same as before. It's been happening for
at least 18 months now. If I'm lucky, on a good day I'll have no pain at all. But on
a bad day it's pretty constant.
Does it ever wake you up at night?
I never sleep very well. I usually wake up because of poor breathing.
The pain you get during the day, is it when you're hungry or after eating?
Before I eat. After I eat the pain usually goes away at first, but then it comes back
again after about 30 minutes. It depends what I'm eating though. If it's something like
oranges or lemons, they seem to be too acidic.
Hmm. Ever had any problems swallowing food or liquid?
No, nothing like that. But it can feel like it's burning on the way down if I drink something
hot.
I see. Anything else you can think of?
I often burp a lot after eating or drinking. That actually helps me feel better. I've never
really vomited, even when I've been feeling my worst. But I can get this terrible taste
to my mouth when I'm burping. It's like something very bitter. Sour almost.
Have you ever coughed up any blood or noticed any blood in your stools?
No, thank goodness.
Okay. Are you on any medication?
I used to take tablets for my ulcer. They were red and yellow. Blowsick, that's them.
I'd take one for every 20 days. They seem to work quite well, as I remember. That's it,
though. I don't really like taking a lot of pills. It sounds like apart from this trouble,
you're quite well then. Yes, touch wood. My wife and I eat a pretty healthy diet, I think.
I never go out to pubs, but I have a glass of wine with dinner a few nights a week.
I used to smoke 10 or 15 cigarettes a day, but I quit two months ago. What about your family's
medical history? Well, I have seven brothers and two sisters. They're all well and living in Spain.
My mother died at 90 of a heart attack and my father at 77 of a stroke.
Like I said, I've never really had any problems myself apart from this pain.
I suppose I'm worried in case it's cancer.
Well, all of your tests have been fine and your GP did a heart rate test and that was alright too.
I'd like to examine you and send you for some blood tests.
I'm going to go.
